Internal AI Governance, Partner Framework & White-Label Expansion

Brand: Digital Transition Marketing
AI Bot: Neon Vision
Purpose: Define AI governance, internal safety policies, and partner/white-label frameworks for scaling while maintaining control and compliance.

1. Internal AI Governance & Safety

Neon Vision enforces a human-in-the-loop AI governance model across all services:

Rules & Policies

Human Oversight: No AI publishes externally without human approval unless explicitly contracted.

Model Version Pinning: GPT-5, LLaMA-4, Gemini, and proprietary fine-tunes are pinned per client to avoid drift.

Data Privacy: AI never uses cross-client data without explicit consent.

Ethics Compliance: No political, fake engagement, or restricted content.

Audit Trails: All AI decisions logged for review and compliance verification.

Monitoring & Control

Real-Time AI Watchdog: LLaMA-4 monitors autonomous processes, flags anomalies, and prevents policy violations.
